prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 34 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1220; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with acute pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture, and the physical examination findings were consistent with that diagnosis. The mechanism of injury, a forward impact transmitted through an outstretched hand, is well matched to the nature and severity of the fracture. No prior injury or treatment involving this wrist is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered over 34 visits, beginning with immobilization and orthopedic follow-up, then progressing to supervised range-of-motion and strengthening exercises. Treatment followed a typical recovery course, with visit frequency decreasing as function and pain improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. At discharge the patient had improved grip strength and wrist mobility and was released to independent home exercise.
